{{MoreSources}}
[[File:Galaxy1.png|thumb|right|300px|A realspace view of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]]]
{{Quote|See that up there? That's space...|Captain [[Kreezo]]|<ref name="SWG:JtL">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]''</ref>}}
'''Realspace''', known by the [[Vagaari/Legends|Vagaari]] as '''crawlspace'''<ref name="Outbound Flight">[[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']]</ref> and usually referred to simply as '''space''' by those living within it, referred to the [[Universe/Legends|known universe]] when viewed by an observer traveling at less than the [[Lightspeed/Legends|speed of light]]. Filled almost entirely with [[Vacuum/Legends|vacuum]], but containing [[Star/Legends|stars]], [[Planet/Legends|planets]], and other astronomical bodies, it was the dimension within which [[Human/Legends|Humans]] and nearly all other [[Species/Legends|inhabitants]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] lived.

Other distinct dimensions were [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], through which [[Starship/Legends|starships]] could travel faster than light; [[Subspace/Legends|subspace]], which was utilized for [[Subspace transceiver/Legends|faster-than-light communication]]; and [[otherspace]], the home dimension of the [[Charon/Legends|Charon]] species.

Traveling in particularly isolated areas of space known as ''deep space'' for extended periods of time led to the condition known as [[deepsick]], which caused [[Brain/Legends|mental]] and emotional breakdown.
